select a.id as teacherId, realName, userImage, Biography, sex, age, eamil, telPhone, qq, campus, views, price, (select ifnull((select count(*) from common_tutoring_comment a where teacherId = a.id and assess > 3),0)/ifnull(count(*),0) from common_tutoring_comment a where teacherId = a.id) as evaluate, (select sum(classHour) from common_tutoring_purchase where teacherId = a.id and status = 1) as learnTime, (select ifnull(avg(assess),5) from common_tutoring_comment where teacherId = a.id) as score, (select count(DISTINCT studenterId) from common_tutoring_purchase where teacherId = a.id and status = 1) as learnNumber, (select ifnull((select count(DISTINCT studenterId) from common_tutoring_purchase where teacherId = a.id and status = 1 group by studenterId having count(*)>1 ),0)/ifnull(count(DISTINCT studenterId),0) from common_tutoring_purchase where teacherId = a.id and status = 1) as renew from common_tutoring_user a where deleted = 0
and a.id in (select DISTINCT teacherId from common_tutoring_subject where subjectId = #{subjectId})
and a.id in (select DISTINCT teacherId from common_tutoring_subject where period = #{period})
and a.id in (select DISTINCT teacherId from common_tutoring_subject where period = #{period} and subjectId = #{subjectId})
and sex = #{sex}
order by views desc
order by createdt desc

select a.id as teacherId, realName, userImage, Biography, sex, eamil, telPhone, qq, age, campus, views, price, (select ifnull((select count(*) from common_tutoring_comment a where teacherId = a.id and assess > 3),0)/ifnull(count(*),0) from common_tutoring_comment a where teacherId = a.id) as evaluate, (select sum(classHour) from common_tutoring_purchase where teacherId = a.id and status = 1) as learnTime, (select ifnull(avg(assess),5) from common_tutoring_comment where teacherId = a.id) as score, (select count(DISTINCT studenterId) from common_tutoring_purchase where teacherId = a.id and status = 1) as learnNumber, (select ifnull((select count(DISTINCT studenterId) from common_tutoring_purchase where teacherId = a.id and status = 1 group by studenterId having count(*)>1 ),0)/ifnull(count(DISTINCT studenterId),0) from common_tutoring_purchase where teacherId = a.id and status = 1) as renew from common_tutoring_user a where realName like #{realName} and deleted = 0 order by createdt desc

select id as commentId, message, assess, userType, (select count(id) from common_tutoring_comment_thumbs where commentId = a.id and userId = #{parenterId} and deleted = 0 limit 1 ) as isLike, (select count(id) from common_tutoring_comment_thumbs where commentId = a.id) as likeNumber from common_tutoring_comment a where deleted = 0 and teacherId = #{teacherId} order by id desc;
